seoTitle: HTML Minifier Online - Compress HTML Code
metaDescription: Free online HTML Minifier. Compress your HTML code by removing whitespace, comments, and line breaks to improve website load speed and SEO.
intro: Looking to boost your website's page speed score? Our free HTML Minifier removes unnecessary characters from your code, drastically reducing file size without changing how the page looks.
whatIs: The HTML Minifier is a web developer tool that compresses raw HTML code. It safely strips out human-readable formatting elements like spaces, tabs, line breaks, and comments to optimize the file for faster browser parsing.
howToUse: Paste your raw, formatted HTML code into the input area.
The tool instantly generates a dense, compressed block of HTML.
Copy the minified code and paste it into your production environment.
howItWorks: The tool uses JavaScript Regular Expressions to safely find and remove HTML comments `<!-- comment -->`, replace multiple consecutive spaces with a single space, and delete entirely empty lines or line-breaks between HTML tags.
workedExample:
A 15-line navigation menu filled with tabs and spaces is fed into the tool. The tool outputs a single continuous line: `
  • Home
`, saving 30% in file size.
resultInterpretation: The resulting code is extremely difficult for humans to read but perfect for machines. The smaller file size translates directly to faster download times for your users.
useCases: Web Deployment: Preparing static HTML files before uploading them to a live server to save bandwidth.
SEO Optimization: Improving Core Web Vitals and Google PageSpeed Insights scores by reducing the 'Time to First Byte' (TTFB).
Email Marketing: Minifying HTML email templates so they load instantly and avoid being clipped by email clients like Gmail.
tipsAndLimitations: Always keep an un-minified version of your code for future editing. Once HTML is minified, it is very annoying to edit manually.
Be careful if your HTML relies on whitespace between `<span>` or `<a>` tags for visual spacing, as aggressive minification might remove those spaces.

faq.question: Does minifying HTML change the website?
faq.answer: No. The browser ignores extra spaces and comments anyway when rendering the visual page. Minification just removes the characters before the browser has to download them.

faq.question: How much space does minifying save?
faq.answer: Depending on how heavily formatted your original code is, minifying can reduce HTML file sizes by 10% to 30%.

disclaimer: This tool performs standard regex-based minification. Always test your minified code in a staging environment to ensure no critical formatting spaces were lost.
